# Pikbo

> Pikbo is subscription-based AI software from Pikbo Labs LLC, a Wyoming limited liability company. It turns an owned designer-toy photo into short launch-video drafts for listings, reveals, and social posts.

Pikbo labels cached Lab prototypes honestly. Cached previews do not process a visitor upload. Live generation, billing, durable credits, and protected delivery remain gated until their production checks pass. Generated angles and product details must be compared with the physical toy before commercial publishing.

## Usage notes

- Only upload photos, packaging, logos, and characters you own or are authorized to use.
- Cached Pikbo Lab media is prototype evidence, not visitor-generated UGC.
- Pikbo does not guarantee sales, reach, rankings, exact unseen details, or unlimited generation.
